metric_definitions.independent_unit: fresh vLLM server process per cell and repetition
metric_definitions.itl_seconds: mean interval between successive content-bearing SSE events; this is a client-observed stream-event measure and may differ from engine token ITL
metric_definitions.output_throughput_tokens_per_second: successful actual output tokens / measured wall-clock interval
metric_definitions.token_counts: server-reported usage must equal tokenizer-controlled request targets
metric_definitions.tpot_seconds: (completion timestamp - first-token timestamp) / (actual output tokens - 1); null for <=1 token
metric_definitions.ttft_seconds: first content-bearing SSE event timestamp - request start
